title: The Resistance Takes Flight
description: Led by a revitalized Poe Dameron, Resistance X-wing fighters arrived on Takodana to combat the First Order. A fierce dogfight promptly ensued, with ships being blasted out of the sky and many Stormtroopers dying as a result of strafing runs. In the midst of this chaos, Han Solo watched his ruthless son, Kylo Ren, carrying an unconscious Rey to his ship. The Resistance soon prevailed over the First Order and a rescue plan for the kidnapped scavenger was set in motion.
section: Star Wars: The Force Awakens #14 of 20
